name: Tetrahydrocannabutol
summary: Tetrahydrocannabutol is a documented other compound on PsychonautWiki.

pharmacology.text: Δ9-THCB, showed an affinity for the human CB1 (Ki = 15 nM) and CB2 receptors (Ki = 51 nM) comparable to that of Δ9-THC. The formalin test in vivo was performed on Δ9-THCB in order to reveal possible analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties. The tetrad test in mice showed a partial agonistic activity of Δ9-THCB toward the CB1 receptor. THCB has rarely been isolated from cannabis samples, but appears to be less commonly present than THC or THCV.

uses.text: THCB was studied by Roger Adams as early as 1942.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. As a THC-like cannabinoid, it would be expected to cause dry mouth, red eyes, a racing heart, anxiety or paranoia, poor short-term memory and impaired coordination.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。作為類似THC的大麻素，預期它會造成口乾、眼睛發紅、心跳加速、焦慮或妄想、短期記憶變差與協調受損。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。作为类似THC的大麻素，预期它会造成口干、眼睛发红、心跳加速、焦虑或妄想、短期记忆变差与协调受损。

fact.en: THCB has a four-carbon tail, one carbon shorter than THC's. It was identified as a natural compound in cannabis by the same Italian research group that found THCP.
fact.zh: THCB的尾鏈有四個碳，比THC少一個碳。發現THCP的同一個義大利研究團隊也確認了它是大麻中的天然成分。
fact.zhHans: THCB的尾链有四个碳，比THC少一个碳。发现THCP的同一个意大利研究团队也确认了它是大麻中的天然成分。
